title: DNA Transfer Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather required consumables
steps.instruction: Collect the Opentrons OT‑2 robot, Opentrons P10 Multi‑Channel Pipette, Opentrons 10 µL tips, an Axygen 96‑Well Plate (PCR‑96‑FS‑C), Micronics 96‑Tube plate (MP52757S‑Y20), and the DNA samples.

steps.title: Load deck with labware
steps.instruction: Place the Axygen 96‑Well Plate in Slot 2, the Micronics 96‑Tube plate in Slot 3, and the Opentrons 10 µL tip rack in Slot 5 of the OT‑2 deck.

steps.title: Select P10 mount and volume
steps.instruction: In the protocol setup, choose the P10 Multi mount (left or right) and specify a transfer volume of 10 µL of sample DNA from the Micronics tubes to the wells of the Axygen plate.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App (version 3.15.0 or later) and input the required protocol parameters as prompted.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: After entering the parameters, click the button to download the generated protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 Run App, upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the OT‑2 App to calibrate the tip rack, the Axygen plate, the Micronics tube plate, and the P10 Multi pipette using the provided calibration tips.

steps.title: Execute the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App to start the DNA transfer protocol.
